verdict.rationale: Belvo's own marketing names recurring payment products: Direct Debit ('Accept recurring bank payments') and Smart Transfers ('Automate recurring payments with Pix'). Its Smart Collections docs also describe Belvo watching the account and collecting set amounts once balance conditions are met. The evidence is mostly homepage taglines, with no detailed developer documentation of the recurring consent or mandate flow. missing for 10: documented standing-consent/VRP or mandate setup API, recurring schedule/limit parameters, developer-level flow docs for Direct Debit/Smart Transfers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, recurring bank payments are supported — variable recurring payments, standing consents, or documented recurring debit flows built on the connection

citations.quote: Direct Debit — Accept recurring bank payments seamlessly
Smart Transfers — Automate recurring payments with Pix
you tell Belvo the amounts you want to collect as well as the balance conditions to wait for and Belvo watches the account in the background
